scope.target: optimize the measured PYTHON_ASSEMBLY/load_balance wall without changing formulation or solver policy

allowed_changes: linear load assembly and balance implementation
mutation-sensitive cache for immutable mesh-quality metrics
forbidden_changes: solver method, convergence thresholds or defaults
multiprocessing, Numba or Cython in this lot

baseline_policy.source: corrected 026-G12 Lot-2 evidence captured before this optimization

acceptance.numerical: same status, global nnz and displacement checksum; residual remains finite and within the existing route policy
acceptance.resource: stop cleanly at 300 seconds or 4 GiB RSS for assembly-only probes; classify RESOURCE_LIMITED
acceptance.memory: reject any optimization whose memory growth is disproportionate to the measured CSR/DOF trend

method_policy.load_balance: direct nodal contributions and vectorized contiguous translation layout
method_policy.quality_cache: cache only geometry/connectivity/threshold-dependent quality values; invalidate on mutation
method_policy.batch_strategy: existing bounded stiffness chunk size 256; no global element-by-element dense array
